---
title: "BANCAT – Alok Nibash Patient Registry Report"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    toc_float: true
    fig_caption: true
    theme: flatly
    highlight: tango
    self_contained: true
params:
  filtered_data_1:  NULL
  monetary_data:    NULL
  growth_rate_data: NULL
  gender_count:     NULL
  sections:         !r character(0)
  date_from:        !r Sys.Date()
  date_to:          !r Sys.Date()
  gender_filter:    "All"
  cancer_filter:    "All"
  age_filter:       "All"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(kableExtra)
library(scales)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo      = FALSE,
  message   = FALSE,
  warning   = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.width = 6.5,
  fig.height= 3.5,
  dpi       = 90
)

# Colors
clr_purple <- "#462C7D"
clr_dark   <- "#2C3E50"

# Section flags
show_trends     <- "trends" %in% params$sections
show_age_gender <- "age_gender" %in% params$sections
show_economic   <- "economic" %in% params$sections
show_family     <- "family" %in% params$sections
show_map        <- "map" %in% params$sections
show_cancer     <- "cancer" %in% params$sections
options(kable_styling_bootstrap_options = c("bordered", "striped", "hover", "condensed"))
# Data aliases
df     <- params$filtered_data_1
mdata  <- params$monetary_data
gdata  <- params$growth_rate_data
gcount <- params$gender_count

# Cumulative registrations
cum_data <- df %>%
  group_by(registration_date) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(registration_date) %>%
  mutate(cumulative_count = cumsum(count))
```


```{css, echo=FALSE}
caption {
  color: #2C3E50 !important;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.95em;
}
```

## Applied Filters

```{r filter-summary}
data.frame(
  Filter = c("Date Range", "Gender", "Cancer Type", "Age filter","Total Patients in Report"),
  Value  = c(
    paste(format(params$date_from, "%d %b %Y"), "–", format(params$date_to, "%d %b %Y")),
    params$gender_filter,
    params$cancer_filter,
    params$age_filter,
    format(nrow(df), big.mark = ",")
  )
) %>%
  kbl(booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "", col.names = NULL) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position", full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
```

```{r s1-header, eval = show_trends, results='asis'}
cat("\\newpage\n# Admission Trends\n\n")
total_pts  <- max(cum_data$cumulative_count, na.rm = TRUE)
avg_growth <- round(mean(gdata$growth_rate, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
cat(sprintf(
  "**Total registered patients:** %s \\hspace{1.5cm} **Monthly avg. growth rate:** %s%%\n\n",
  format(total_pts, big.mark = ","), avg_growth
))
```

```{r s1-cumplot, eval = show_trends, fig.height=3.6,dpi = 150, dev = "png", fig.cap="Cumulative Patient Registrations Over Time"}
ggplot(cum_data, aes(registration_date, cumulative_count)) +
  geom_area(fill = clr_purple, alpha = 0.28) +
  geom_line(color = clr_purple, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "6 months") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(x = "Registration Date", y = "Total Patients",
       title = "Cumulative Patient Registrations") +theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

```{r r s1-growth, eval = show_trends}
gdata %>%
  filter(!is.na(growth_rate)) %>%
  select(date_label, monthly_new, cumulative_count, growth_rate) %>%
  mutate(growth_rate = paste0(growth_rate, "%")) %>%
  kbl(
    booktabs  = TRUE,
    linesep   = "",
    col.names = c("Month", "New Patients", "Cumulative Total", "Growth Rate"),
    caption   = "Monthly Growth Rate of New Admissions",
    align     = c("l", "r", "r", "r")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position", full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
```

```{r s2-header, eval = show_age_gender, results='asis'}
avg_age <- round(mean(df$age, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
cat(sprintf(
  "\\newpage\n# Patient Demographics — Age & Gender\n\n**Average patient age:** %.1f years\n\n",
  avg_age
))
```

```{r s2-age-table, eval = show_age_gender}
age_tbl <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Percentage = paste0(round(Count / sum(Count) * 100, 1), "%"))

kbl(age_tbl, booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "",
    col.names = c("Age Group", "Count", "% of Patients"),
    caption = "Age Group Distribution") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position", full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
```

```{r r s2-gender, eval = show_age_gender}
gcount %>%
  filter(!is.na(patient_gender)) %>%
  mutate(
    count = format(count, big.mark = ","),
    pct   = paste0(round(pct * 100, 1), "%")
  ) %>%
  kbl(
    booktabs  = TRUE,
    linesep   = "",
    col.names = c("Gender", "Count", "% of Patients"),
    caption   = "Gender Distribution",
    align     = c("l", "r", "r")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position", full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
```

```{r s2, eval = show_family}
avg_hs <- round(mean(df$household_size, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
avg_ch <- round(mean(df$num_children,   na.rm = TRUE), 2)

data.frame(
  Metric = c("Average Household Size",
             "Average Number of Children per Household"),
  Value  = c(avg_hs, avg_ch)
) %>%
  kbl(booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "",
      col.names = c("Metric", "Average Value"),
      caption   = "Family Dynamics Summary") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position", full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
```

```{r s3-header, eval = show_economic, results='asis'}
cat("\\newpage\n# Patient Demographics — Economic Situation\n\n")
```

```{r s3.1-cost, eval = show_economic}
avg_exp <- mean(mdata$average_treatment_cost, na.rm = TRUE)

mdata %>%
  mutate(
    average_treatment_cost = paste0("BDT ", format(average_treatment_cost, big.mark = ",")),
    average_yearly_income  = paste0("BDT ", format(average_yearly_income,  big.mark = ","))
  ) %>%
  select(Year, average_treatment_cost, average_yearly_income) %>%
  kbl(
    booktabs  = TRUE, linesep = "",
    label     = "cost",
    col.names = c("Year", "Avg. Treatment Cost", "Avg. Yearly Income"),
    caption   = paste0("Treatment Cost by Year  |  Overall Avg: BDT ",
                       format(round(avg_exp, -3), big.mark = ",")),
    align     = c("l", "r", "r")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position", full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(nrow(mdata), bold = TRUE)

pov_line <- 10000; low_line <- 25000
breaks   <- seq(0, 40000, 5000)
```

```{r s3.2-income, eval = show_economic}
df %>%
  filter(!is.na(family_income), family_income > 0, family_income <= 40000) %>%
  mutate(band = cut(family_income, breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE,
                    labels = paste0(format(breaks[-length(breaks)], big.mark = ","),
                                   " – ", format(breaks[-1], big.mark = ",")))) %>%
  count(band, name = "Patients") %>%
  mutate(
    Share = paste0(round(Patients / sum(Patients) * 100, 1), "%"),
    Zone  = case_when(
      as.integer(band) <= which(breaks == pov_line) - 1 ~ "Poverty",
      as.integer(band) <= which(breaks == low_line) - 1 ~ "Low Income",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  kbl(
    booktabs  = TRUE, linesep = "",
    label     = "income",
    col.names = c("Income Band (BDT)", "Patients", "Share", "Zone"),
    caption   = "Monthly Household Income Distribution",
    align     = c("l", "r", "r", "l")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position", full_width = FALSE)

```

```{r s5-header, eval = "map" %in% params$sections, results='asis'}
cat("\\newpage\n# Patient Distribution by District\n\n")
```

```{r s5-table, eval = show_map}
site_short <- c(
  "Reproductive (Female)"                    = "Repro. (F)",
  "Reproductive (Male)"                      = "Repro. (M)",
  "Other cancers (brain ocular and thyroid)" = "CNS/Ocular/Thyroid"
)

district_totals <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(district)) %>%
  mutate(district = as.character(district)) %>%
  count(district, name = "total") %>%
  mutate(pct = round(total / nrow(df) * 100, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total))

cancer_lines <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(district),
         !is.na(major_cancer_sites),
         !major_cancer_sites %in% c("Unknown", "Not Applicable")) %>%
  mutate(
    district = as.character(district),
    site     = as.character(major_cancer_sites),
    site     = dplyr::recode(site, !!!site_short)
  ) %>%
  count(district, site, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(district) %>%
  mutate(site_pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  summarise(
    cancer_str = paste(paste0(site, " (", n, ", ", site_pct, "%)"),
                       collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

district_totals %>%
  left_join(cancer_lines, by = "district") %>%
  mutate(district_label = paste0(district, "-(", total, ", ", pct, "%)")) %>%
  select(district_label, cancer_str) %>%
  kbl(
    linesep   = "",
    col.names = c("District (n, %)", "Cancer Site (n, %)"),
    caption   = "Patient Distribution by District",
    align     = c("l", "l")
  ) %>%
 kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("bordered", "striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width        = FALSE
  )%>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "11cm")
```


```{r s6-header, eval = show_cancer, results='asis'}
cat("\\newpage\n# Patient Medical Summary — Cancer Types\n\n")
```

```{r s6-barplot, eval = show_cancer, fig.height = 5, dpi = 150, dev = "png", fig.cap = "Major Cancer Sites by Patient Count"}
df_cancer <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(major_cancer_sites),
    !major_cancer_sites %in% c("Unknown", "Not Applicable")
  ) %>%
  count(major_cancer_sites, name = "count") %>%
  mutate(
    pct   = count / nrow(df),
    label = paste0(round(pct * 100, 1), "%")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(count))

ggplot(df_cancer, aes(reorder(major_cancer_sites, count), count)) +
  geom_col(
    fill      = "#DFF1F1", color = clr_dark,
    linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.9, width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), hjust = -0.15, size = 3, color = clr_dark) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18)))+theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of Patients",
       title = "Patients by Major Cancer Site")
```

```{r s6-table, eval = show_cancer}
df %>%
  select(major_cancer_sites, cancer_affected_body_parts) %>%
  filter(!is.na(major_cancer_sites),
         !major_cancer_sites %in% c("Unknown", "Not Applicable"),
         !is.na(cancer_affected_body_parts)) %>%
  count(major_cancer_sites, cancer_affected_body_parts, name = "count") %>%
  group_by(major_cancer_sites) %>%
  mutate(
    major_count   = sum(count),
    major_pct     = round(major_count / nrow(df) * 100, 1),
    body_part_pct = round(count / major_count * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(major_cancer_sites, desc(count)) %>%
  mutate(
    site_label = if_else(
      row_number() == 1,
      paste0(major_cancer_sites, " (n=", major_count, ", ", major_pct, "%)"),
      ""
    ),
    detail = paste0(cancer_affected_body_parts, ": ", count, " (", body_part_pct, "%)")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(site_label, detail) %>%
  kbl(
    booktabs  = TRUE,
    linesep   = "",
    col.names = c("Cancer Site", "Affected Body Part (n, %)"),
    caption   = "Major Cancer Sites and Affected Body-Part Breakdown",
    align     = c("l", "l")
  )%>%  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c( "striped"),
    full_width    = FALSE
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "11cm")
```
